name: VirusTotal
summary: Scans files, URLs and domains with over 70 antivirus engines and blocklisting services.
description: Submit an item through the web interface, desktop uploaders, browser extensions or the REST API, and get a report that combines over 70 antivirus scanners and URL/domain blocklisting services with tools that extract signals from the content. Public and private API tiers are metered by consumption quotas; premium products include VT Intelligence, IOC Reputation, VT Hunting, VT Graph and Private Scanning, and an MCP-based entry point (VTAI) exists for AI agents.
contains: over 70 antivirus scanners and URL/domain blocklisting services per scan
submission routes: web interface, desktop uploaders, browser extensions, REST API
API can scan files and URLs, fetch reports and comment on samples (x-apikey auth)
premium services: VT Intelligence, IOC Reputation, VT Hunting, VT Graph, Private Scanning
AI agent entry point: keyless MCP-based VTAI at ai.virustotal.com
